text: hey we had setup uh instantmesh for 3d generation but i dont remember the command to run it lol can u make  a better command for it so its just a single verb and then path to the image i am using, i know the config file used was instant-mesh-large.yaml
resolution: Created tools/instantmesh: a single-verb wrapper for the InstantMesh image->3D pipeline so the user no longer needs to remember the verbose 'conda activate instantmesh && cd deps/InstantMesh && python run.py configs/instant-mesh-large.yaml --output_path outputs --export_texmap' incantation. Usage is now just 'tools/instantmesh ./photo.png'. The wrapper resolves the image to an absolute path, activates the instantmesh conda env, cd's into deps/InstantMesh, runs run.py against instant-mesh-large.yaml with texmap export on by default, and prints the resulting .obj path. Friendly flags (--out/--config/--no-rembg/--no-texmap/--seed/--steps/--views/--video) translate to run.py's flags and any unknown flag is forwarded verbatim. Syntax-checked and error paths (missing/nonexistent input) verified; did not run a full multi-minute generation.
